title: trifolium pratense subsp. kotulae
intro: Trifolium pratense subsp. kotulae, commonly known as a subspecies of red clover, is a perennial legume native to Eastern Europe. It is traditionally valued for its potential health benefits, which include alleviating menopausal symptoms, supporting cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and estrogenic properties, which may also contribute to its use in wound healing and as an anticoagulant. The bioactive constituents of Trifolium pratense subsp. kotulae include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
